name: Sunken Temple
description: An ancient temple rising from the Whispering Marshes, pulsing with serpent-green magic.

temple_entrance.title: Temple Threshold
temple_entrance.description: Massive stone doors stand open, revealing stairs descending into green-lit darkness. Water drips from the ceiling. Serpent statues flank the entrance, their eyes seeming to follow your movement.

outer_sanctum.title: Outer Sanctum
outer_sanctum.description: A circular chamber with a flooded floor. Green light emanates from beneath the water. Ancient pillars carved with serpents rise from the depths. Passages lead deeper.

encounters.description: Cultists and their undead servants rise from the water!

offering_chamber.title: Chamber of Offerings
offering_chamber.description: Stone altars stained with old blood line the walls. Recent offerings—coins, weapons, jewelry—lie scattered about. Something valuable glints in the shadows.

encounters.description: Green gas hisses from vents in the floor!

drowned_library.title: Drowned Library
drowned_library.description: Shelves of waterlogged books and scrolls. Most are ruined, but some texts remain readable, written in ancient scripts. Cultist notes and maps are scattered on a stone table.

hall_of_coils.title: Hall of Serpent Coils
hall_of_coils.description: A long hall lined with massive serpent statues. Their coils wrap around pillars reaching to the vaulted ceiling. The floor is covered in knee-deep water that reflects the eerie green light.

encounters.description: Two massive serpents slither out from behind the statues!

inner_sanctum.title: Inner Sanctum - Heart of the Temple
inner_sanctum.description: The temple's central chamber. A massive pool of dark water fills the center, glowing with unnatural light. The serpent altar rises from the pool's center. High Priest Korvash stands before it, arms raised, chanting in a language that makes your ears bleed. Around the pool, cultists join in the ritual.

encounters.description: High Priest Korvash turns from his ritual, dark magic swirling around him! 'You are too late! The key is ours!' His followers surge forward!
